(viii) P4S10 + H2O → H3PO3 (phosphorous acid). Phosphorus in H3PO3 has three bonds and one lone pair → trigonal pyramidal geometry.
Thus reactions with trigonal pyramidal geometry around the named element: (iv), (vi), (viii). Total = 3.
